meta.description: Ruslan Mukhtarov, founder of MKR. Former French Wrestling Team, INSEP 2012-2016. Everything is handled for French-speaking athletes in the Caucasus.

hero.label: ABOUT
hero.title: IMMERSION AMONG CHAMPIONS.
hero.subtitle: MKR Caucasian Camp was founded by Ruslan Mukhtarov, former French Wrestling Team (INSEP 2012-2016). Here is why he created this camp.

history.label: OUR STORY
history.title: WHY MKR EXISTS
history.p1: The best fighters come from the same place. The Caucasus. Wrestling in Dagestan, MMA in Chechnya: two schools, one heritage. Yet no one offers structured access to these training methods for European athletes.
history.p2: Ruslan Mukhtarov spent four years at INSEP on the Olympic wrestling team (2012-2016), representing France. From his travels to Dagestan and Chechnya came a simple conviction: this door had to open for French-speaking athletes, with every logistical obstacle removed. MKR stands for Mukhtarov, his family name. MKR Caucasian Camp, which many simply call MKR Camp or MKR, is his.
history.quote: "I wanted to build this camp so that as many athletes as possible, in MMA and Wrestling, could take part. Make the travel and the stay easy. You don't have to think about anything, just pack your bag."

cinematic.alt: Athletes in collective prayer at the MKR camp, heritage and discipline of the Caucasus
cinematic.label: HERITAGE
cinematic.title: MORE THAN A CAMP
cinematic.tagline: Discipline, Caucasian heritage, mat brotherhood. An experience that marks the body and the mind.

mission.quote: "Our mission: give French-speaking athletes access to the most effective combat training methods in the world, in an authentic and supervised setting."

pillars.label: OUR PILLARS
pillars.title: WHAT MKR DOES NOT COMPROMISE ON
pillars.subtitle: Four principles that guide every session, every selection, every coach chosen. Non-negotiable.

authenticity.title: AUTHENTICITY
authenticity.body: Not a Caucasus-inspired camp. THE camp in the Caucasus. Real gyms, real local coaches, an atmosphere you cannot fake.

discipline.title: DISCIPLINE
discipline.body: Two training sessions a day, six days a week. Not sport tourism: the mat rigor that builds world champions.

fraternity.title: BROTHERHOOD
fraternity.body: You are welcomed as one of their own. Sparring with locals, shared meals, family evenings. The mat builds bonds.

transmission.title: TRANSMISSION
transmission.body: Wrestling in Dagestan for centuries. MMA in Chechnya for 30 years. You receive a heritage, not a technique.

team.label: TEAM · FOUNDER
team.title: WHO WE ARE
team.subtitle: One founder, a team in France, on-site partners. Everything is designed so a French-speaking athlete only has to think about their bag.
team.ruslan_portrait_alt: Ruslan Mukhtarov in a black suit, founder of MKR Caucasian Camp
team.ruslan_bio_p1_strong: Born in Dagestan, of Chechen origin
team.ruslan_bio_p1_after_strong: , trained on the French Wrestling Team at INSEP (2012-2016). A triple belonging that opens doors no one else can open for a French-speaking athlete.
team.ruslan_bio_p2: Under the suit, the wrestler. On the mat, the former French Team athlete. In the Caucasus, the son of the land. That is what makes access to the gyms of Makhachkala, Kaspiysk and Grozny possible: Ruslan is known, expected, respected.
team.ruslan_bio_p3: Today he runs the MKR camps, supports every candidate over video calls, manages partner coaches and gyms, and trains alongside the participants on site.
team.france_body: All admin and social media are run from France. Visa, flight, transfer, accommodation, prep: you have a French-speaking contact at every step, before and during your camp.
team.onsite_body: In Dagestan as in Chechnya, MKR has its local partners. They join you in the training gyms, alongside Ruslan, and bridge with the day-to-day Caucasian coaches.

dkdp.label: PARTNER AND DIGITAL
dkdp.title: DKDP AGENCY ON THE TECH
dkdp.subtitle: Website, content, communication. MKR Caucasian Camp does not move forward alone: the camp relies on a Geneva-based partner agency for everything digital.
dkdp.david_photo_alt: David Khazaei, director of DKDP agency and digital partner of MKR Caucasian Camp
dkdp.david_bio_p1_after_link: agency, based in Geneva. Ruslan's partner on MKR Caucasian Camp since the start of the project: he leads the website, the content and all digital communication for the camp.
dkdp.david_bio_p2_before_strong: An amateur kickboxer, David also teaches
dkdp.david_bio_p2_strong: kids' classes at Strike Academy in Geneva
dkdp.david_bio_p2_after_strong: . Two arenas, one same conviction: the rigor of the mat carries over to the screen.
